Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: MamadouKernel
Message:
security: pentest round 2 — hardening and findings

Captures the per-request auth hardening that was in the working tree but not in
the previous commit, plus fixes found during a second penetration-test pass.

Hardening (verified by security.spec.ts 30/30 and security-extended.spec.ts 12/12):
- OnTokenValidated: every request re-reads the account (suspended -> 401), the
  session (logged-out -> 401) and the admin roles (revoked admin -> 403); roles
  are no longer trusted from the JWT alone
- 2FA: a login challenge that exhausts its attempts now locks the account, not
  just the challenge, bounding second-factor brute force
- logout revokes the specific session (sid); account deletion also purges
  notification preferences, push subscriptions, trusted devices, phone codes and
  payout accounts
- Web Push endpoints restricted to known push hosts (SSRF guard)
- per-client, per-day booking cap (4) to prevent slot hoarding
- gift-card code entry and the admin audit route put behind their policies/limits

Pentest fixes:
- a NUL byte in a search term or e-mail returned 500 (error leak); it is now a
  400 via InvalidInputExceptionHandler (closes the only ZAP 500)
- nginx no longer logs the SignalR access_token: /hubs/ uses a log format that
  drops the query string

Report: docs/PENTEST.md gains an honest second-round section. No critical/high
app-level findings; the strong attack surfaces (auth bypass, token/role/session
revocation, cross-tenant IDOR on lots 5-7, CSV formula injection) all hold.
Residual low items (slot cap is per-establishment-monthly as well, promo-code
enumeration under the global limiter only, transitive dependency advisories,
dev-compose port exposure) are documented.

E2E: growth waitlist test spreads the day's bookings across 3 accounts to respect
the new daily cap.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: MamadouKernel
Message:
feat: v1.0.1 - nouvelle architecture Angular + API .NET, avec fonctions marchandes et avis

Application reconstruite : API .NET 10 (monolithe modulaire, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, SignalR),
site Angular 21 (PWA, signaux), tests unitaires, d'integration, Vitest et de bout en bout.

Annuaire et fiche
- fiche en onglets (prestations avec bouton Reserver, realisations, avis, a propos), ouvert maintenant
- avis clients apres un rendez-vous termine, reponse du partenaire, masquage par un administrateur
- favoris, tri Mieux notes, note moyenne partout
- carte plein ecran avec carrousel de salons (nom, telephone, commune, quartier, prestations)
- navigation mobile a quatre onglets, tuiles OpenStreetMap servies par le cache du site

Abonnements et facturation
- formules parametrables, periode d'essai, changement de formule avec prorata,
  promotions en pourcentage et codes promo, paiement des abonnements via WiniPayer

Autres
- espace partenaire (KYC, agenda, videos, moyens de paiement), back-office, sauvegardes,
  observabilite OpenTelemetry, Redis, securite durcie (CSP stricte, 2FA obligatoire)
- start.cmd / stop.cmd, mise a jour automatique de l'application, documentation d'etat
